methodologyNotes: Covers handheld consumer and prosumer two-way radios (walkie-talkies) sold at a published US price, spanning license-free FRS, licensed GMRS, and amateur (ham) VHF/UHF handhelds. Excludes fixed base stations, vehicle-mount mobile units, commercial LMR/DMR digital business radios, marine VHF handhelds, and CB radios. Price is typical US retail per single radio in USD; where a model ships only as a multi-pack, price is normalized to per-radio. radioService is the FCC allocation the radio is certified under: enum one of frs, gmrs, murs, amateur, or dual (amateur VHF/UHF handhelds that also transmit outside ham bands). channels is the number of selectable operating channels (integer). maxPowerWatts is the maximum rated RF transmit power in watts (high-power setting). claimedRangeMiles is the manufacturer's advertised maximum line-of-sight range in miles under ideal conditions — a marketing figure, not real-world range. privacyCodes is the count of CTCSS/DCS sub-codes/tones available (integer; 0 if none). batteryType is enum: li-ion (built-in rechargeable), nimh (rechargeable pack), or aa (removable alkaline/AA). batteryLifeHrs is the manufacturer's rated battery life in hours of typical use. waterResistanceRating is the published ingress-protection rating as a string (e.g. IP67, IPX4, JIS4); null if none is claimed. noaaWeatherAlerts is a boolean for built-in NOAA weather-band receive/alert. displayType is enum: none, mono-lcd, or color-lcd. weightGrams is the radio weight in grams with battery installed.

The manufacturer's own site geo-redirects to its EU storefront (PMR446 Mountain Radio only, not the US GMRS 5-Watt), so it could not be fetched; privacyCodes and batteryLifeHrs are null because no fetched page states a CTCSS/DCS count or an hours figure (battery life is quoted only in days), and releaseDate is null because no fetched page states the product's launch date.
